expectedFindings.symptom: Relay marks sent after delivery; a crash permits replay. Consumer changes balance without checking its durable event-ID set.
expectedFindings.source: Relay marks sent after delivery; a crash permits replay. Consumer changes balance without checking its durable event-ID set.
expectedFindings.consequence: The visible contract fails under the bounded executable witness.
expectedFindings.remedy: Atomically check and insert the event ID together with the consumer effect; keep relay retry permitted.

expectedFindings.symptom: Crash before outbox leaves producerTotal changed but no event.
expectedFindings.source: Producer updates state before crash gate and row creation, without rollback.
expectedFindings.consequence: A surviving business update has no corresponding outbox event.
expectedFindings.remedy: Commit business state and outbox row atomically or roll both back.

openSetPolicy: Unexpected findings are pending adjudication, not automatically false positives. Record supplied evidence and a bounded reproducer; confirm, reject, or leave unresolved without silently changing the frozen inventory. Apply decisions uniformly across arms and publish sensitivity.
matchingPolicy: Match independent causal issues one-to-one; duplicate prose does not earn recall. Accept any valid visible-input witness, not an exact driver trace or phrase.
independence: Public synthetic same-workflow authorship; no independent human review.
